# oscal-to-hdf go/testdata — provenance (pre-ADR POA&M files)

Recorded 2026-09-17. These three files pin how a POA&M exported before ADR-0014
imports (ADR-0014 §4.3). They are read by TestConvertPOAMToHDF_PreADRDocument
(converter_poam_test.go) and its TypeScript mirror (typescript/converter.test.ts).

## `poam-pre-adr.v3.6.0-input.json`
The HDF amendments document fed to the v3.6.0 exporter. Its first seven
overrides are the seven `Standalone_Override` examples from
`hdf-schema/src/schemas/primitives/amendments.schema.json` at tag v3.6.0,
verbatim and in order (the same overrides as the first case in
`hdf-converters/shared/oscal-poam-roundtrip-cases.json`). The eighth copies the
first example with `requirementId` set to "", `type` set to `attestation`, a new
reason, and `baselineRef` and `evidence` removed. v3.6.0 accepted an empty
`requirementId` (`hdf validate` passes at v3.6.0); the current schema rejects it,
so this file is valid only against the v3.6.0 schema.

## `poam-pre-adr.json`
Unedited output of the hdf-cli built at tag v3.6.0, converting the input above
to an OSCAL POA&M. Valid against the vendored OSCAL POA&M 1.1.2 schema, which
the test asserts.

## `poam-pre-adr.v3.6.0-import.json`
Unedited output of the same v3.6.0 hdf-cli importing `poam-pre-adr.json` back
to HDF amendments: the pre-ADR mapping the test compares against.

## How they were produced
From a checkout of this repository:

    mkdir v3.6.0 && git archive v3.6.0 | tar -x -C v3.6.0
    (cd v3.6.0/hdf-cli && go build -o ../../hdf-v3.6.0 ./cmd/hdf)
    ./hdf-v3.6.0 validate poam-pre-adr.v3.6.0-input.json
    ./hdf-v3.6.0 convert --from hdf-amendments --to oscal-poam poam-pre-adr.v3.6.0-input.json -o poam-pre-adr.json
    ./hdf-v3.6.0 convert poam-pre-adr.json -o poam-pre-adr.v3.6.0-import.json

The exporter mints fresh uuids on every run, so a rerun matches
`poam-pre-adr.json` only with uuids masked, and the import's `integrity`
checksum (a hash of the input bytes) changes with them.
